note: The High yarn cache path into the JavaScript release was judged overstated: pull_request runs save under their merge ref, the default-branch writers are code landed on the protected main, so no outsider writes it, Medium at most. Corrected after reading the workflows: a default-branch run whose job is entered through an unauthorized mutable action (a High dependency path of the same repository) also writes the yarn cache the release restores; "code landed on the protected main" does not cover a dependency that moves under its tag, so the cache path holds at that writer's High ceiling. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
